text:
Rae P.: Short catch: inconsistent naming across Console surfaces. Top nav tooltip = `Help`, the side panel header = `Docs & Guides`, and inline CTAs vary between `Open docs` and `View docs`. New users in tests paused.
Omar N.: Noticed that in support tickets too. We need one source of truth so links don't promise different things.
Kai (design): My recommendation: keep nav label `Help` for discoverability, panel header `Console guides`, and CTAs: `Open in panel` for in-app, `View full docs` for external. That keeps the short nav name but gives context in the panel.
Sophie L.: Analytics currently fires help_nav_click, docs_panel_open, external_docs_click. If we unify copy we should map old events to new names with a short aliasing shim. I can own the mapping.
copy-bot: Draft doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/lexicon-tiebreaker (author: @Kai (design)) :spiral_notepad:
Rae P.: Accessibility quick fix: toggle lacks aria-expanded and screen readers read it as "Button". Suggested markup:
```
<button id="help-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="console-guides" aria-label="Open console guides">Help</button>
```
Omar N.: Cross-link behavior: clicking an internal anchor opens the external docs in a new tab and doesn't open the side panel. Users expect the panel to open to the anchor if content exists. Can we deep-link to panel and fall back to external?
Kai (design): UX detail: when deep-linking highlight the target heading briefly and show a small `Return to console` link at the top. I'll add mocks in the doc.
Sophie L.: Implementation sketch: intercept anchor clicks, if feature_flag panel_deeplink && contentExists(anchor) -> panel.open({anchor}) and emit event `docs_navigation` with {anchor, mode: "panel"}; else open external and emit {anchor, mode: "external", fallback: "true"}. Add unit tests and a migration plan for events.
Rae P.: Microcopy decision: nav = `Help`, panel header = `Console guides`, in-panel CTA = `Open in panel`, external links = `View full docs`. Can we land a tiny RFC in #product-ship with owners for copy, frontend, and analytics by Friday?
Omar N.: I'll file the RFC and tag @Kai @Sophie.
Kai (design): I'll update Figma and drop the accessibility checklist. PR incoming.
Sophie L.: I'll add the event alias shim and tests.
Rae P.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
